bullets.text: Streamlined Container Management - **VS Code** now integrates **Copilot** for easier container management, enhancing developer focus.
Smart Shopping with Copilot - **Microsoft Edge** introduces **Copilot** features for a seamless holiday shopping experience.
Xbox Gaming Experience Enhanced - **Windows 11** users can now enjoy a full-screen **Xbox** gaming experience on handhelds.
Web Install API Testing - **Microsoft Edge** launches the **Web Install API** for improved web app installation experiences.
AI-Driven Security Operations - **Microsoft Defender Experts** integrates AI to enhance SOC efficiency and threat response.
